player_prompt.intro:
Kei te tākaro koe i te panga RushHour {difficulty}. Whakakīkī ngā motokā kia haere ai te motokā whero [X] ki te taha matau.
Mahi: [A+], [B-], ētahi atu. (+ = whakamua, - = whakamuri).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hēhea te whakatinana. Whakamahia te tauira [A+] / [B-].
invalid_move.no_car: Kāore he waka "{car_id}" i runga i te papa.

game_message.solved: Ka whakaitihia te waka whero! Kua whakatauhia e koe te kupu taumira.
